TZA.note: Says registration data is a foundation for statistics but names no published statistics from records.
No link between civil register and ID system stated.

facts.fact: Minister Juma Homera said birth registration coverage rose from 55 per cent in 2020 to 68 per cent in 2025, a national rate not tied to a digital system, with a target of 100 per cent by 2030.

TZA.note: Gives birth registration rates only, no count of people holding a national ID.
No ID number given at birth is stated.
Nothing on who runs or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.
NIDA cards are mentioned only in passing, with nothing on the system.
Only says investment continues in digital registration systems; no office entry of events stated.
